title: “Grillz on a hijabi”: Intersectional Identities in Fostering Critical AI Literacy
reasoning: The paper centers on the intersectional identities of Black Muslim teen girls as a primary resource for evaluating AI. It specifically examines how their religious identity and traditional garments (such as hijabs and abayas) interact with the socio-ethical limitations and biases of generative AI, making faith-based cultural knowledge a core component of the study's critique of AI ethics.
